$comment: Field meanings and the standards they map to are documented at https://fossfoundation.info/crosswalk and in the JSON-LD context api/v1/crosswalk/context.jsonld. Vocabularies: Schema.org https://schema.org/, Dublin Core https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/, W3C PROV-O https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/, Package URL https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec (ECMA-427).
title: Foundation Platform Crosswalk Schema
description: Accounts and packages a foundation (or one of its hosted projects) controls on code hosts and package registries, each with the evidence for that link. Confidence is computed from the evidence by assets/python/fdncrosswalk, never stored. Holds identifiers only: metrics such as stars or downloads stay in ecosyste.ms.

identifier.title: Foundation identifier
identifier.description: Matches the identifier of a file in _foundations/.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Orgs, namespaces or owners on code hosts and registries. Include rejected look-alike accounts so they are not added again by mistake.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Packages and source repositories that belong to the foundation or one of its hosted projects. For each project, list its main package first: it is copied to the purl column of _data/projects-<foundation>.csv.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Code host or registry, using the ecosyste.ms host or registry name where one exists.

host.title: Self-hosted instance
host.description: Base URL of a self-hosted forge (for example https://gitlab.eclipse.org) when platform does not name the instance.

kind.title: Account kind
kind.description: organization: a forge or registry org account; namespace: a name prefix such as an npm scope or Maven groupId; user: a single owner account.

name.title: Name
name.description: Login, scope (with @), groupId, or owner handle exactly as the platform spells it. Joins to the ecosyste.ms owner login or namespace name.

platformId.title: Platform id
platformId.description: The platform's stable numeric id for the account, which survives renames (GitHub's org id, also served as the ecosyste.ms owner uuid). Lets tools detect a renamed or re-registered account.
platformId.$comment: Maps to Schema.org identifier (https://schema.org/identifier); see OpenSSF advice on rename attacks: https://repos.openssf.org/trusted-publishers-for-all-package-repositories

url.title: URL
url.description: Public page for the account on the platform.

project.title: Hosted project
project.description: Identifier of a hosted project (as in _data/projects-*.csv, where the foundation has one) when the account belongs to that project rather than to the foundation itself.

lastReviewed.title: Last reviewed
lastReviewed.description: Date a person last reviewed this whole account and its evidence.

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed by
reviewedBy.description: GitHub login of the person who last reviewed this account.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Why we believe the foundation or project controls this account. At least one item.

purl.title: Package URL
purl.description: Package or source repository as a purl without a version, for example pkg:pypi/numpy or pkg:github/apache/kafka. Joins to the ecosyste.ms package or repository purl and to the papers index.
purl.$comment: Package URL (ECMA-427): https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec; maps to Schema.org identifier (https://schema.org/identifier) as CodeMeta does: https://codemeta.github.io/terms/

codeRepository.title: Code repository
codeRepository.description: URL of the package's source repository.

account.title: Account
account.description: The account the package is published under, as <platform or host>/<name>, matching an entry in accounts.

project.title: Hosted project
project.description: Identifier of the hosted project the package belongs to.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Why we believe the package belongs to the foundation or project. At least one item.

person.title: Person confirmed with
person.description: The person at the organization who confirmed the link.
person.$comment: A Schema.org Person (https://schema.org/Person) in an OrganizationRole (https://schema.org/OrganizationRole); the same shape as people in the leadership dataset.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person's name. Optional; leave it out if they prefer.

email.title: Email
email.description: The person's email address. Record it only with their agreement, since this repository is public.

roleName.title: Role
roleName.description: The person's role at the organization, for example VP Infrastructure.

memberOf.title: Organization
memberOf.description: Identifier of the organization the role is at; defaults to this crosswalk's foundation.

type.title: Evidence type
type.description: steward-declared: the foundation's own site or policy names it. platform-verified: the platform checked a domain or identity for it. human-attested: a trusted person confirmed it out of band with someone at the organization. profile-claim: the account's own profile names the foundation or its website. program-badge: a platform program badge, such as Docker Hub's open source badge. publish-provenance: a trusted-publishing attestation shows releases built in a repository owned by another linked account. repository-link: package metadata points into a linked code host account. namespace-convention: the name follows a documented convention tied to the foundation's domain or forge account. name-match: same name only. contradiction: evidence that someone else controls it.

source.title: Source
source.description: URL where the evidence can be checked again. For human-attested evidence, the pull request or signed commit that recorded it.

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: Date the evidence was last checked, or the date a human attestation was done.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: What the source shows, in one sentence.

creator.title: Recorded by
creator.description: Who recorded the evidence: a person's GitHub login, or fdncrosswalk/<version> for the probe tool. For human-attested evidence, the attestor's login as listed in _data/attestors.json.

about.title: About
about.description: The specific release the evidence is about, as a purl with a version, for example pkg:pypi/pyperf@2.10.0.

method.title: Method
method.description: How a human attestation was confirmed.

validThrough.title: Valid through
validThrough.description: Date after which the evidence should be checked again. Defaults to one year after observed for human-attested and steward-declared evidence, and 90 days for the rest.

supersedes.title: Supersedes contradictions
supersedes.description: Set true on a human-attested item, by a listed attestor and observed after the contradiction, to override earlier contradiction evidence; explain why in detail.
